import re
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

# load current module
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask','/work/textmask.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

# baseline behavior from original implementation
def baseline_masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split('-')), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

def baseline_name_tokens(name: str):
    return sorted({name} | set(name.split('-')), key=len, reverse=True)

cases = [
    ("Hello anna-maria and anna and maria", "anna-maria"),
    ("AB cde f-gh", "f-gh"),
    ("Use a+b and a and b", "a+b"),
    ("MiXeD Case Name", "Name"),
    ("tiny an on no", "an-no"),
    ("repeat repeat-name repeat", "repeat-name"),
]

ok = True
for text, name in cases:
    b = baseline_masked(text, name)
    n = mod.masked(text, name)
    print('case', (text, name))
    print(' baseline:', b)
    print(' new     :', n)
    if b != n:
        ok = False

# token checks
for name in ['anna-maria','x-y-z','Name','a+b','repeat-name']:
    b = baseline_name_tokens(name)
    n = mod.name_tokens(name)
    print('tokens',name, b, n, 'match', b==n)
    if b != n:
        ok = False

print('ALL_OK', ok)
